gemma3-1b.paper_V_note: tab:tokenizers prints 256,000; the tokenizer this row was measured on has 262,144 entries. See module docstring.
gemma3-1b.embed_rows_gate_reason: gemma-3-1b-pt's <image_soft_token> sits at id 262144 == config.vocab_size (262144), so vocab_size_total (262145) exceeds the embedding rows by exactly that one token. The gate guards LM training against out-of-range embedding lookups; this sweep computes MorphScore from tokenizer offsets alone and instantiates no model.

olmo3-7b.paper_V_note: Not one of tab:tokenizers' 11 families (paper_row=None; excluded from PAPER_GRID). OLMo-3-7B is the paper's own base model and appears separately in sec:olmo / tab:morph-expanded-olmo-perlang, an unreproducible 19-language, 10k-line-corpus, single-seed sweep this family entry exists to replace with an artifact-backed cell grid under THIS driver's 50k-line protocol. paper_V=100278 is config.vocab_size, confirmed via AutoConfig.from_pretrained and identical to the fitted tokenizer's vocab_size_total (100278 entries + 22 added tokens, all within the same 100278 ids) -- not a tab:tokenizers citation.
olmo3-7b.old_overlays_not_reused: las_tokenizers/olmo3-7b_v100k_fineweb2sample_10klines_* were fit under a different (10k-line) protocol and are NOT read or reused by this driver; this family's base and overlays are refit at the sweep's 50k-line protocol under las_tokenizers/intrinsic_sweep_v2/<protocol_tag>/olmo3-7b/.

phi-3-mini.excluded: microsoft/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct's tokenizer.json has pre_tokenizer: null (its space handling lives entirely in a Prepend+Replace normalizer). The base-Unigram conversion pre-tokenizes the corpus with the pre-tokenizer and validate_tokenizers requires it to be non-null, so this family cannot be converted by this pipeline. Confirmed by a failed conversion attempt on 2026-08-27; excluded by decision 2026-08-28. No substitute was used.

tab:tokenizers Gemma row |V|.evidence: The row's Devanagari-Complete count (13,684 in tab:deva-eng-subwords) is reproduced exactly by google/gemma-3-1b-pt and not by google/gemma-2-2b (1,514). gemma-3-1b-pt's tokenizer has 262,144 vocab entries (262,145 counting the added token at id 262144); the published 256,000 is Gemma 2's size.

tab:tokenizers Gemma row label.problem: Gemma 2 and Gemma 3 do not share a tokenizer: 256,000 vs 262,144 entries, 1,514 vs 13,684 Devanagari-Complete pieces. One row cannot cover both. The measurements in the paper are Gemma 3's.
